title: Testing World Models on Actions They Have Never Seen: Held-Out Plans, Forecast Accuracy and Price Rules in Retail
abstract: arXiv:2611.22537v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A world model is trusted to answer "what if": how its world responds to an action it has never seen. We give a test of that trust for any action-conditioned world model: actions held out of training by design and scored against a known answer; whether forecast accuracy predicts accuracy on those actions; and the same structure given to simpler models. We run it in retail, where the action is a price and promotion plan, across 2,853 fitted models. First, forecast accuracy is a fair guide between kinds of model (rank correlation with error on new plans 0.32 to 0.66) and a poor guide between versions of one world model: where merchants plan into high-demand weeks the link reverses, down to -0.69. Second, training the world model to learn the effect of actions (JEPA pretraining, a latent consistency check, adaptation at the plan date) leaves its error on new plans unchanged. translated_title: 在从未见过的动作上测试世界模型：零售业中的留出计划、预测准确度与价格规则
translated_abstract: 世界模型被信任来回答“如果……会怎样”的问题：即它的世界如何响应一个它从未见过的动作。我们为任何以动作为条件的世界模型提供了一种检验这种信任的测试：通过设计将动作从训练数据中留出，并对照已知答案进行评分；检验预测准确度能否预测模型在这些动作上的表现；以及将相同的结构应用于更简单的模型。我们在零售场景中运行该测试，其中动作是价格和促销计划，共涉及2,853个拟合模型。首先，预测准确度是在不同类型模型之间进行比较的合理依据（与新计划上的误差的秩相关性为0.32至0.66），但对于同一世界模型的不同版本之间则是一个糟糕的依据：在商家将计划安排到高需求周的情况下，这种相关性会发生反转，低至-0.69。其次，训练世界模型学习动作的效果（JEPA预训练、潜在一致性检查、计划日期处的适配）并不会降低其在新计划上的误差。第三，在生成的世界中，记录的常规价格和三个p……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种检验动作条件世界模型对从未见过的动作泛化能力的测试方法，并在零售定价场景的2,853个模型中发现：预测准确度仅能可靠地区分不同类型的模型，却无法区分同一世界模型的不同版本（在高需求周甚至出现反转），且JEPA预训练等学习动作效果的训练技术并未降低模型在新计划上的误差。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a test for action-conditioned world models on held-out actions they have never seen, and shows across 2,853 retail pricing models that forecast accuracy reliably ranks model types but not versions of a single world model (even reversing in high-demand weeks), while training techniques like JEPA pretraining to learn action effects leave error on new plans unchanged.
